name: Kondalu
caption: Ep 1/10 — 10 rojullo chelli engagement, almirah lo kondalu 😭 #DostUndiGa #IronDost #Hyderabad #LBNagar #TeluguReels

clips.title: Almirah avalanche
beats: Camera inside the grey steel almirah looking out: the door is already swinging open on frame 1 and a huge wave of crumpled shirts, sarees, towels and lungis blasts toward the lens in slow motion. Behind the flying clothes RAVI, in a grey vest and checked lungi, flinches with both arms raised and his mouth open.
The wave crashes over RAVI and buries him; the camera pushes back with the clothes until only his head and one arm stick out of a waist-high mountain of clothes on the mosaic floor.
RAVI blinks and blows a sock off his face; it flops onto his head.
On the sofa at the right edge, BUNTY in his maroon printed shirt holds an open foil biryani parcel, laughs and points his spoon at RAVI.
clips.camera: Starts inside the almirah looking out as the door opens, pulls back with the clothes wave in one move, and settles on a medium-wide shot of the clothes mountain with BUNTY on the sofa at the right.

lines.native: क्या रे, कपड़ों का चारमीनार बना दिया क्या?
lines.roman: Kya re, kapdon ka Charminar bana diya kya?
lines.en: What, did you build a Charminar out of clothes?

clips.sound: Door creak and whoosh at 0.0 s, a heavy cloth thud at 2 s, a soft 'phff' as Ravi blows the sock at 4.5 s, Bunty's laugh from 6.5 s
clips.first: The almirah door already swinging open, clothes mid-air flying at the lens, RAVI's raised arms behind them.
clips.last: RAVI's head and one arm sticking out of the clothes mountain with a sock on his head; BUNTY laughing on the sofa with the biryani parcel.
clips.edit_text: 0.3 s: '10 rojullo chelli engagement.' 1.2 s: 'Clean battalu: 0' (big, top third)
neg_extra: clothes turning into smoke, liquid or a creature
BUNTY standing up or leaving the sofa

clips.title: Amma calls
beats: Close-up: RAVI, still half-buried in the clothes, pulls a vibrating phone out of the pile and presses it to his ear with both hands. The back of the phone faces the camera.
RAVI listens; his eyes go wide with panic and he swallows.
RAVI forces a huge fake smile and nods hard, as if Amma could see him.
The fake smile holds while his eyes slide sideways to the clothes mountain around him in despair.
clips.camera: Slow push-in from a medium close-up to a tight close-up of RAVI's face.

lines.native: రవీ, దివ్య నిశ్చితార్థానికి ఇంకా పది రోజులే! నీ బట్టలు రెడీ నా?
lines.roman: Ravi, Divya nischitartham ki inka padi rojule! Nee battalu ready na?
lines.en: Ravi, only ten days to Divya's engagement! Are your clothes ready?

clips.sound: Phone vibration at 0.0 s, Amma's voice slightly tinny through the phone speaker, soft room tone
clips.first: RAVI's hand pulling a buzzing phone out of the clothes pile.
clips.last: Tight close-up of RAVI's frozen fake smile, eyes sliding to the clothes around him.
clips.edit_text: Kinetic captions for both lines; '10 rojulu' pops in red at 3 s
neg_extra: a visible phone screen or call screen
RAVI's lips moving while Amma speaks

clips.title: No dhobi, but there's an app
beats: Medium two-shot. BUNTY, licking biryani off his fingers on the sofa, waves a hand toward the window as if the answer is easy.
RAVI, sitting on the clothes pile, shakes his head and slumps.
RAVI's phone pings. He looks down at it; the phone faces away from the camera and a soft royal-blue glow lights his face from below.
RAVI taps the phone with his thumb, the blue glow brightens, and a slow hopeful smile spreads across his face. BUNTY leans over, curious.
clips.camera: Starts on BUNTY, slow pan left to RAVI, ends on a close-up of RAVI's face lit blue with BUNTY leaning into the edge of frame.

lines.native: गली के धोबी को दे दे.
lines.roman: Gali ke dhobi ko de de.
lines.en: Just give it to the dhobi in the lane.
The dhobi went back to his village.

lines.native: ఈ యాప్ చూడు రా, ఎల్ బి నగర్ లో ఇంటికొచ్చి తీసుకెళ్తారు.
lines.roman: Ee app chudu ra, LB Nagar lo intikochi teeskeltaru.
lines.en: Look at this app, in LB Nagar they come home and pick up.

clips.sound: Bunty's finger-lick, a notification ping at 5 s, Amma's voice note through the phone speaker, a soft tap at 7 s
clips.first: BUNTY on the sofa with the biryani parcel, waving toward the window.
clips.last: RAVI's face lit royal blue from the phone, smiling; BUNTY leaning in at the edge of frame.
clips.edit_text: 5.5 s: 'Amma ❤️ sent a voice note'; 7.5 s: 'IronDost app → Book pickup' (edit graphic next to the phone)
neg_extra: a readable phone screen, app UI or WhatsApp chat
any light colour other than royal blue from the phone

clips.title: Naa lucky shirt, jagratta
beats: RAVI stands and holds up his navy checked lucky shirt on a hanger in front of him with both hands, very seriously, like something precious.
He tucks a small closed red velvet ring box into the shirt's chest pocket and pats the pocket twice.
BUNTY leans into frame from the right with one sceptical raised eyebrow, still holding his spoon.
RAVI hugs the shirt to his chest and looks worried; the camera drifts in on the pocket with the ring box.
clips.camera: Medium shot of RAVI with the shirt; BUNTY enters frame right; slow push-in that ends close on the shirt pocket.

lines.en: This is my lucky shirt. Careful with it.

lines.native: ऑनलाइन वाले कपड़े गायब कर देते, देख लेना.
lines.roman: Online wale kapde gayab kar dete, dekh lena.
lines.en: Online people make clothes vanish, you'll see.

clips.sound: Hanger clink at 0.5 s, two soft pats on the pocket at 4 s, a low suspense swell of room tone at the end (no music)
clips.first: RAVI holding the navy checked lucky shirt on a hanger at chest height.
clips.last: Close on the shirt pocket with the red ring box inside, RAVI's worried face soft behind it.
clips.edit_text: Cliffhanger at 8.5 s: 'Repu udayam 7 gantalaki…' then the end card
neg_extra: the ring box turning into a phone or wallet
